back_translation: Hear this, O priests! Pay attention, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you, because you have been a snare at Mizpah and a net spread out on Mount Tabor.
The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I will discipline them all.
I know Ephraim well, and Israel is not hidden from Me. O Ephraim, now you have played the harlot, and Israel is defiled.
Their deeds do not allow them to return to their God, for a spirit of harlotry is within them, and they do not know the LORD.
Israel's arrogance testifies against them; Israel and Ephraim stumble in their iniquity, and even Judah stumbles with them.
They will go to seek the LORD with their flocks and herds, but they will not find Him, for He has withdrawn Himself from them.
They have been treacherous against the LORD, for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the New Moon festival will devour them along with their land.
Blow the ram's horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; raise the battle cry in Beth-aven: behind you, O Benjamin!
Ephraim will become a desolation on the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.
The princes of Judah are like those who move boundary stones; I will pour out My fury upon them like water.
Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, because he is determined to follow worthless idols.
So I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like rot to the house of Judah.
When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent envoys to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.
For I will be like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I, even I, will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, and no one can rescue them.
I will return to My place until they admit their guilt and seek My face; in their affliction they will earnestly seek Me.
